rbac_roles.responsibilities: School-wide analytics, staff management, financial tracking, approvals, policy broadcasts, compliance.
rbac_roles.permissions: Global read/write, user management, audit logs, administrative approvals.

rbac_roles.responsibilities: Class rosters, grade book, daily attendance tracking, lesson planning, student feedback, homework assignment.
rbac_roles.permissions: Class-bounded read/write (assigned classrooms & enrolled students only).

rbac_roles.responsibilities: Student performance monitoring, attendance alerts, fee invoice/payment, direct teacher messaging.
rbac_roles.permissions: Child-bounded read access, payment submission, messaging initiation.

rbac_roles.responsibilities: Coursework access, homework submission, exam schedules, learning materials, report cards.

microservices.name: Auth & Identity Service
microservices.scope: Multi-tenant credentials, role hierarchies (Principal -> Teacher -> Student/Parent links), session invalidation, parent-child association graphs.

microservices.name: Academic & Grading Service
microservices.scope: Subject catalogs, syllabus schedules, assignment creation, grading rubrics, gradebook exports.

microservices.name: Attendance & Operations Service
microservices.scope: Ingests daily attendance logs (manual or biometric/RFID), school calendars, timetables, leave management.

microservices.name: Communication & Notification Service
microservices.scope: Real-time push alerts, emergency SMS broadcasts, parent-teacher messaging via WebSockets, scheduled email reports.

microservices.name: Fee & Billing Service
microservices.scope: Tuition schedules, invoice generation, payment gateway integration, receipt reconciliation.

storage_architecture.cache_and_realtime: Redis (Session tokens, active attendance caches, Pub/Sub message broker)
storage_architecture.object_storage: MinIO / S3 (Homework uploads, report card PDFs, lesson plans, system backups)

agents.name: Principal Copilot (Institutional Health & Risk Analytics)
capabilities: Early Warning Engine: Time-series anomaly detection across attendance, disciplinary notes, and grades to surface dropout/failure risks.
School Operations Summarizer: Automatically compiles weekly operations digests.
Policy & Communication Drafter: Drafts administrative announcements and safety alerts grounded in handbooks via RAG.

agents.name: Teacher Copilot (Curriculum & Grading Assistant)
capabilities: Differentiated Lesson Planner: Creates multi-tiered lesson plans, quiz questions, and assignments.
Draft Evaluation & Rubric Scoring: Pre-grades essays and descriptive responses against a strict rubric.
Parent Update Generator: Summarizes individual student progress into constructive updates for parent-teacher meetings.

agents.name: Parent Assistant (Academic Interpreter)
capabilities: Performance Translation: Converts report cards and homework metrics into plain-language actionable advice.
Multilingual Translation: Translates teacher notices, consent forms, and messages into the parent's primary language.

agents.name: Student Tutor (Grounded Study Companion)
capabilities: Curriculum-Grounded Socratic Tutor: Provides guided hints from approved textbooks and notes via RAG without giving away direct answers.
Revision Schedule Optimizer: Generates adaptive revision quizzes based on past mistakes and upcoming exams.

rag_and_vector_engine.partitioning: Strict isolation by student grade, enrolled course IDs, and role permissions.

inference_engines.structured_reasoning: Large coding and reasoning models for rubrics, report generation, multi-step policy tasks.
inference_engines.real_time_tutors: Low-latency 3B to 7B parameter local models for interactive Q&A, spelling/grammar reviews, and quick Socratic suggestions.

guardrails_and_compliance.zero_pii_leakage: PII (student IDs, contact details, medical records) is stripped or pseudonymized before prompts reach the inference engine.
guardrails_and_compliance.system_prompt: You are a safe, pedagogical assistant for school students. Never provide direct solutions to homework questions; provide conceptual hints. Cite strictly from verified course context provided. Immediately flag self-harm, harassment, or abuse signals to the school counselor.
guardrails_and_compliance.audit_ledger: All AI evaluations and communications log raw inputs, model metadata, and outputs to an immutable audit ledger.
